description: New General ACCDB. T(ID Long primary key, K TEXT(40)) with the first 10 pair-corpus values (a, A, b, B, e, E, e-acute, E-acute, e-grave, e + combining acute); image kept. CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_K ON T (K) (equal-comparing values present), image kept, then the index metadata and a UX_K walk (does a refused build leave a trace); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_KID ON T (K, ID), image kept. TU(ID, K) with unique index UX on K and rows a and b; image kept; INSERT of A (refused?), image kept; UPDATE of b to A, image kept; INSERT of a Null and a second Null, image kept. Asks what a refused unique build, insert and update leave in the file and in the index list, and which rows the unique index admits.
